name: Blackfly S BFS-U3-04S2M-C

sources.title: Blackfly S USB3, model BFS-U3-04S2M-C (Teledyne Vision Solutions product page)
sources.covers: resolution, frame rate, sensor (Sony IMX287), pixel size, sensor format, shutter, mono, C-mount, synchronisation, interface, exposure range, ADC, size, mass, power

note: A cased mono USB3 Vision camera with a C-mount. Sold without a lens, so no FOV, f-number or focus is stated: the imager has no FOV and the library uses its labelled default until the user enters the chosen lens (or a calibration). Sony IMX287, 720 x 540, 1/2.9", pixel size "6.9" (the page gives no unit; the sensor's pixel is in micrometres), maximum frame rate 522 fps; ADC 8, 10 and 12 bit; pixel formats are not listed on the page, so the stream format is null. Exposure "4 us to 30 seconds". power_w is the stated maximum, 3 W (5 V via USB3 or 8-24 V via GPIO). size_mm is the stated 29 x 29 x 30 mm (W x H x L), entered as [30, 29, 29] with L along the optical axis. Connectors USB3 Micro-B and Hirose HR10A-7R-6PB (GPIO).

sync.what: Specifications, Synchronization: "Software trigger, hardware trigger, action command"; opto-isolated input and output.
